deleteModal.title: Delete location
deleteModal.warningsTitle: Deleting this location will affect the following:

alert.blocking: This location cannot be deleted because of the following reasons:
alert.warning: Deleting this location will have the following consequences:

deleteModal.preflightError: Unable to verify whether this location can be deleted. Please try again.

errors.hasExclusiveMarketplaceComponentConfigs: One or several tabs in the Member Area are set to only display this location's calendar and workshops, please update them before deleting the location.

warnings.hasRelatedStaffConfigurations: This location is used for access monitoring by one or several staff members. By deleting the location without selecting a new one, they will not be able to perform access monitoring anymore.
warnings.exclusiveAssociatedCoaches_one: Your teacher {{- coach_name}} is only notified when a substitution request is made for a session in this location. By deleting the location, they will therefore receive substitution requests from every location.
warnings.exclusiveAssociatedCoaches_other: Your teachers {{- coach_name}} are only notified when a substitution request is made for a session in this location. By deleting the location, they will therefore receive substitution requests from every location.
warnings.hasRelatedAssociatedCoaches: Some teachers are notified when a substitution request is made for a session in this location. By deleting the location, they will stop receiving the notification for it.
warnings.hasRelatedMarketplaceComponentConfigs: The calendar and workshop tabs configured for the Member Area will not display this location calendar anymore.
warnings.hasRelatedMarketingNotifications: Notifications linked to this location will be deleted.

info.reportsDefault: The location will be deleted from past reports.
info.widgetsDefault: Calendar and Workshops widgets may be configured with this location, please do not forget to update them.

emptyState.title: No venues archived yet
emptyState.subtitle: Any venues moved here can be restored

alert.blocking: This venue cannot be archived because of the following reasons:
alert.warning: Archiving this venue will have the following consequences:

errors.hasUpcomingOffers: Some upcoming sessions take place in this venue. Please cancel and delete them before archiving.
errors.hasUpcomingPrivateBookings: Some upcoming appointments take place in this venue. Please cancel and delete them before archiving.
errors.hasExclusiveBillingGroup: This venue is the last one of its billing group. Please delete or update this billing group before archiving.

errors.exclusivePaymentPacks: The following passes {{names}} are only usable in this venue. Please update their restrictions before archiving.
errors.hasExclusiveMarketplaceComponentConfigs: This venue has exclusive marketplace component configurations. Please update them before archiving.
errors.isIntegratedInPartnership: This venue is integrated in a partnership. Please remove the integration before archiving.
